entries.name: Командный модуль A
entries.prompt:
This is a peaceful studio asset reference for an entirely fictional science-fiction RTS videogame, depicting only a static non-operational game prop. No people, combat, real-world weapon instructions or functional internals. Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce a corrected detailed 3D modeling turnaround sheet of EXACTLY the approved building in input image 1, not a redesign. Input image 1 is the sole authoritative geometry, proportions and material reference. Keep its precise silhouette, relative widths/heights/depths, bevel character, structural arrangement, number of functional pieces and orange paint placement. Derive all views by mentally rotating ONE fixed 3D object, never independently redesign its sides. Where the original hides a wall, continue the same coherent shell simply; do not duplicate the front or invent additional machinery. This is an engineering asset reference, strict realistic restrained proportions, same rich detailed hard surface finish as input, NOT a schematic or simple blockout. Flat neutral studio grey background. All gates/caps closed, all lights/lenses dark, no emissive materials, sparks, beams, smoke, glow, or animation effects. Orange is diffuse paint only. 
Layout: landscape 3:2 sheet, 3 columns x 2 rows, six clearly separated equal cells with small labels. Top row FRONT, RIGHT, REAR. Bottom row TOP, FRONT 3/4, REAR 3/4. Fill cells generously without cropping. FRONT looks directly at the building's functional front along its longitudinal axis; RIGHT is exactly 90 degrees around it; REAR is exactly 180 degrees from FRONT; TOP is straight vertically down with the building front at bottom of page, not an elevated perspective. Orthographic front/right/rear/top use one common scale and flat elevations (no visible roof in front or rear). FRONT 3/4 faithfully preserves the reference geometry and proportions, REAR 3/4 shows that same model from the opposite diagonal. Camera moves only; every moving mechanism stays in EXACTLY the same rest pose in all six cells. Do not rotate the building relative to its own base between cells. Visual consistency is more important than adding tiny details. No invented dimensions, ruler marks or callout diagrams.
BUILDING SPECIFIC LOCKS:
Human standalone command module A. Fixed squat octagonal tan housing with slanted dark buttresses, TWO side towers/bearing supports, ONE large outer tilting ring and ONE concentric inner rotating ring. Preserve exact reference ratio of ring diameter to building width and EXACT rest tilt from reference. Do not change ring tilt between cameras. TOP must project the tilted ring as an ELLIPSE, never a full circle; RIGHT must show ring edge-on slant and both bearing support positions if visible, not another 3/4 frontal ellipse. Front/rear exact straight elevations, rear no duplicated front door. No horizontal active pose on this sheet. No electrical discharges.

entries.name: Наземная турель C
entries.prompt: Create a six-view character-independent asset turnaround of this fictional RTS game ground defense turret prop in a neutral grey studio. This is visual game concept art only. Match the supplied original exactly, fixing mismatched proportions across views. Show FRONT, RIGHT, REAR, TOP, FRONT 3/4, REAR 3/4 in a 3x2 grid. Same one thin barrel, same left-side tall shield, same rear-left orange box, same flat square base in every view. Same horizontal rest pose in every panel, top barrel points down. Preserve original realistic hard surface finish and materials; all lights off, no shooting, people or action. Do not add or remove parts. Rear must show back of the same shield and orange box, not a new invented assembly. Copy the reference silhouette and relative sizes closely.
